title: Ghost PowerToys Run window when using Win+, while PowerToys Run is open

status.label: Recorded PowerToys Run focus bug
status.detail: The issue provides a two-step reproduction and a recording of the residual window.

next_action.label: Design dismissal fix
next_action.reason: The foreground-window transition is specific enough to investigate without additional diagnostics.

actions.label: Design PowerToys Run ghost-window fix
actions.note: Investigate PowerToys Run dismissal and visual teardown when Win+, changes foreground state, with comparison to Win+D and Command Palette. This drafts no upstream mutation.

judgment.rationale: The report has a minimal deterministic sequence and video evidence, sufficient for targeted focus/dismissal investigation even though it was observed on 0.100.2.
evidence: The reproduction is to open PowerToys Run and then press Win+,.
The expected result is dismissal, while a ghost PowerToys Run window remains.
The reporter attached a recording and notes that Win+D does not produce the same result.
judgment.recommended_action: Investigate PowerToys Run foreground-loss and teardown behavior for Win+, and verify that no residual visual surface remains.
